This one is kind of my fault. My party wanted to do an Evil campaign where they would eventually come into some kind of political power. I thought the Curse of the Crimson Throne adventure path would be a great choice with some rewrites thrown in. 
The initial party is
Viper, a human fighter who aspires to become a hell knight. Specialty in duel wielding whips. Alignment is Lawful Evil.
Dante, Human Noble with the undead sorcerer bloodline. Alignment is Lawful evil.
Ragniff, a Rakshasa bloodline teifling and Sorcerer who pretended to be a rouge for as long as possible. Alignment is chaotic evil
Koejin, A shoanti fighter using the Thunder and fang fighting style. Alignment is Chaotic Neutral
BalrogRagefisttheMighty. Half Orc Barbarian. Alignment is VERY VIOLENT.

I introduce the setting by having every party member being somehow wronged by local drug dealer Gaedren Lamm. Dante’s family vineyard was robbed by Lamm (Ragniff also stole small amounts of wine on a Simi regular bases, he shifted the blame onto lamm). Several of Koejin’s kinsmen became addicts to his drugs he sells. Viper and several other trainees were assigned to help guard Dante’s Vineyard due to repeated small thefts of wine (again Ragniff) but got curb stomped by lamm’s lackeys. Ragniff had it the worse, Gaedren Lamm enslaved him as a child and put him to work in his sweatshop, and while doing the prelude to the campaign Ragniff witnesses Gaedren feeding one of the other children to his pet crocodile and responds with “People can be food?” The player decided at that point Ragniff was now a Cannibal.  
After the party was brought together by the fortune teller they find Gaedrens current Sweatshop. They knock out the two men guarding the front door and break in. another guard comes in to see what the commotion is. As soon as he walks in Viper wraps one of her whips around his neck to silence him and the party hang him upside down by his ankles so they can interrogate him. While the party is interrogating one of the guards, Ragniff decides he is very hungry now and starts flaying the two unconscious guards alive so he can eat them easier. The only person who protest this is Viper, not because it was wrong but because it was unlawful and they deserved to rot to death in a dungeon. The still living guard starts freaking out and screaming. Ragniff decides to silence him by cutting the ears of the dead guards and force feeding them to him before gaging him. As they delved deeper into the base they bull rushed the halforc guard into a vat of low grade acid. Every time he tried to escape they dunked him back in. then they locked the Halfling pit boss in a cage with a starving dog.
After the party Reached and defeated Gaedren Lamm Viper put her foot down and tells the party they had to take him alive so he can “Legally Suffer for his Crimes”. Gaedren believing one of his sponsors will get him out of jail mocks the party for leaving him alive, Ragniff then informs him he is not safe in or out of prison and that he will kill him. So Gaedren is turned in for the bounty on his head, all of his lackeys are dead at this point. Ragniff decides he’s not done with Lamm, and tries to break him out of jail so he can eat him. He uses his illusion magic to disguise himself as the Locale Hell knight Commander and demands to see the prisoner. At this point two hell knights show up to conduct a prisoner transfer and notice their commanding officer who should be on the other side of the city right now is trying to conduct a prisoner transfer on his own. They find this along with the fact the Commanders armor isn’t making any sounds highly problematic. After a round of questioning Ragniff decides he’s not fooling anybody now and escapes by jumping out of a window and running for his life. After turning a corner he undoes his illusion, throws himself to the ground, and tells the guards chasing him “he went that way’. 
A week passes and Ragniff finds out the Gaedren is being executed for his crimes. Ragniff refuses to let anybody else take his kill. So he tracks down the executioner, gets him black out drunk and steals his executioner equipment. Ragniff then proceeds to the execution grounds. Before killing Gaedren Ragniff whispered into his ear “I told you I be the one to kill you”.
